import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import kit

MAXSIZE = 512
PATTERNS = ["[a-c][0-9]*(x|y|z)*", "(ab|cd)*[e-h]|[i-l]*m*", "a[b-d][0-9](([x-z])*)*"]
RUNS = 700

def build(pattern):
    types = [{"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
             {"name": "S", "kind": "string", "maxsize": MAXSIZE}]
    modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["s", "S"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
                "requires": ["match", ["var", "s"], pattern]}]
    campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
                "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
    _, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
    payloads = []
    for i in range(RUNS):
        chars = [97 + i % 3] + [48 + (j % 10) for j in range(1, i % MAXSIZE)]
        while len(chars) < MAXSIZE:
            chars.append(120 + (len(chars) % 3))
        chars[i % MAXSIZE] = 0               # truncate somewhere
        payloads.append({"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(
            [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in zip(plan["slots"], chars + [0])])})
    campaign["runs"] = payloads
    return campaign


for pattern in PATTERNS:
    campaign = build(pattern)
    start = time.time()
    out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
    elapsed = time.time() - start
    statuses = {r["status"] for r in out["records"]}
    units = len(pattern) * (MAXSIZE + 1) * RUNS
    print("%-24s %6.2fs for %9d units %s" % (pattern, elapsed, units, statuses))
PYEOF
